portInfo.description: UNESCO describes Tárraco as a major Roman administrative and mercantile city and imperial-cult centre for the Iberian provinces, with excavated monumental remains. APT’s Catalan/Spanish portal covers port governance, Moll de Costa and cruise-city messaging.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Cruise terminal provides access to the city center
gettingThere.publicTransport: Local buses connect terminal to city and train station

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Buy a combined monument ticket plan before wandering between amphitheatre and circus fragments.
